title: Replicating 'Hint Faithfulness' Across the Open-Weight Model Zoo

original_idea.body: Run 6-hint-type protocol across a panel of small open models; fit faithfulness vs size/recipe.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: establishes whether faithfulness findings transfer to accessible models — useful monitoring baseline.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Accessible: run published protocol over a panel of small open models; beginner-friendly.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: cross-model baseline table on a shared MMLU subset.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly replication on open models, weak lab incentive.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference on 7-14B open models; single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Direct cross-model replication; transfer baseline plausibly open.
